signature.description:
The signed JSON Web Token (JWT) of the transaction.

To learn more, see our [Signature](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/signature) feature documentation.

operationProperties.description: An object that contains the configured properties of the operation, which determined how it was carried out.

accountId.description: The ID of the account that carried out the operation.

state.description:
The state of the operation.

**Possible values**: See the [Operation states](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Operation-states) table.

errorCode.description:
The error code that is given if the operation fails.

**Possible values**: See the [Operation error codes](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Operation-error-codes) table.

errorDescription.description: The descriptive error message that is given if the operation fails.

created.description:
The timestamp when the initial response was created.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

completed.description:
The timestamp when the operation was completed.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

device.description: An object that contains information about the ReuseID user's device used for the operation.

user.description: An object that contains information about the ReuseID user used for the operation.

riskAttributes.description:
An object that contains the risk attributes collected for the device.

**Possible values**: See the [Risk attributes](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Risk-attributes) table.

**Note**: To learn how to configure which attributes are collected, see our [Application configuration](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/application-configuration#risk-data) feature documentation.

tags.description: The tags that you added so that the callback events can be filtered.

AppAttestation.description:
An object that describes the properties of the attestation.

**Note**: In order for this object to be returned in the response, it must be enabled in your [application configuration](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/application-configuration#app-attestation).

playIntegrityStatus.description:
The Play Integrity attestation status of the ReuseID user's device that was used for the operation.

**Possible values**: See the [Play Integrity statuses](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Play-Integrity-statuses) table.

playIntegrityDate.description:
The timestamp when the Play Integrity attestation was performed on the ReuseID user's device.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`

appAttestStatus.description:
The App Attest attestation status of the ReuseID user's device that was used for the operation

**Possible values**: See the [App Attest statuses](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/App-Attest-statuses) table.

appAttestDate.description:
The timestamp when the App Attest attestation was performed on the ReuseID user's device.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`

Geofencing.description:
An object that contains information about the geofencing validation.

**Note**: In order for this object to be returned in the response, it must be enabled in your [application configuration](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/application-configuration#geofencing).

countryCode.description:
The country code in an ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 format, as reported by the SDK.

**Possible values**: For a list of countries and corresponding codes, see the [GeoNames](https://www.geonames.org/countries/) website.

clientStatus.description:
The status of the geofencing operation, as reported by the SDK.

**Possible values**: See the [Geofencing client statuses](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Geofencing-client-statuses) table.

serverBoundaryValidation.description:
The status of the geofencing server validation, after evaluating the country against the allowed region.

**Possible values**: See the [Geofencing server boundary validation statuses](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Geofencing-server-boundary-validation-statuses) table.

accuracy.description: The location accuracy of the ReuseID user's device that was used for the operation.

altitude.description: The location altitude of the ReuseID user's device that was used for the operation.

latitude.description: The location latitude of the ReuseID user's device that was used for the operation.

longitude.description: The location longitude of the ReuseID user's device that was used for the operation.

pushSent.description: A property that informs you whether a push notification was sent.

location.description:
An object that describes the location of the device that was used for the operation.

**Note**: To be returned in the response, you need to enable it in your [application configuration](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/application-configuration#risk-data).

sessionExpiryTime.description:
The timestamp when the operation expires.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

clientData.description: The data that the client application optionally passed at the point of the authentication.

authLevel.description:
The authentication level that was used for the operation.

**Possible values**: See the [Authentication levels](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Authentication-levels) table.

sessionTimeout.description: The specified timeout for the operation, given in milliseconds.

metadata.description: The meta data that was set for the operation.

authMethod.description:
The authentication method that was used for the operation.

**Possible values**:
- See the [Authentication methods](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Authentication-methods) table.

sendPush.description:
A parameter that determined whether to send push.

**Note**: For push notifications to be sent, you need to enable them in your [application configuration](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/application-configuration#push-notifications).

broadcast.description: A parameter that determined whether to broadcast the operation to all of the ReuseID user's active devices.

pushPayload.description: A custom payload that was sent to the ReuseID user's device in the push notification.

requestedUserAttributes.description:
The user attributes that were requested for the operation.

**Possible values**:
- If no value was set, then the user object returned after a successful operation will not include any attributes.
- If a non-existent user attribute was set, then this will be silently ignored.

id.description: The ID of the ReuseID user's device (`deviceId`).

name.description: The name of the ReuseID user's device.

id.description: The ID (`userId`) of the ReuseID user, in a valid UUID format.

segment.description: The segment that was assigned to the ReuseID user and their corresponding transactions.

externalRef.description: The identifier generated by you, that points to the `userId` generated by ReuseID.

attributes.description: An object that contains the user attributes that were added to the ReuseID user, given as key-value pairs.

postOperationContext.description:
The context of the operation which is sent to your app, through a secure end-to-end encrypted channel, **after** the operation is successfully completed.

**Note**: To learn more, see our [Operation context](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/operation-context) feature documentation.

title.description: The title of the operation context.

content.description:
The content of the operation context.

**Allowed values**:
- It must be something that your application is able to process, for example a string.
- It cannot exceed the maximum character length in the [Operation context maximum character lengths](#section/Common-concepts/Operation-context-maximum-character-lengths) table.

**Note**: ReuseID handles this as a binary blob.

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the operation context `content`.

**Note**: This must be a valid MIME type, such as `text/plain`.

preOperationContext.description:
The context of the operation which is sent to your app, through a secure end-to-end encrypted channel, **before** the operation is completed.

**Note**: To learn more, see our [Operation context](/docs/mobile-identity/mobileid/features/operation-context) feature documentation.

title.description: The title of the operation context.

content.description:
The content of the operation context.

**Allowed values**:
- It must be something that your application is able to process, for example a string.
- It cannot exceed the maximum character length in the [Operation context maximum character lengths](#section/Common-concepts/Operation-context-maximum-character-lengths) table.

**Note**: ReuseID handles this as a binary blob.

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the operation context `content`.

**Note**: This must be a valid MIME type, such as `text/plain`.
